scope_notes: LSU checks use only public instruction, operand, request and response ports.
Cache data oracles are independent memory/byte-mask models; no internal DUT state is forced.
Paired I/D ports have independent lower-memory responders; this is not a shared-fabric or physical DDR test.
Raw native ModelSim exit codes and wrapper return codes are recorded separately; negatives require actual self-check failure.
Native RAM inference models are RTL simulation, not a physical timing or board test.
